import inspect

from solution import find_Element


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example find_Element([1,2,3,4,5],[[0,2],[0,3]],2,1) == 3."""
    # [1,2,3,4,5] -> [0,2] right => [3,1,2,4,5] -> [0,3] right => [4,3,1,2,5]; [1]=3
    assert find_Element([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [[0, 2], [0, 3]], 2, 1) == 3


def test_issue_zero_rotations():
    """With zero rotations the element at index is unchanged."""
    # no rotation applied, arr[1]=20 so result is 20
    assert find_Element([10, 20, 30], [[0, 2]], 0, 1) == 20


def test_issue_empty_ranges():
    """Empty ranges with zero rotations returns original element."""
    # no ranges to apply, arr[2]=30 so result is 30
    assert find_Element([10, 20, 30], [], 0, 2) == 30


def test_issue_prefix_left_edge():
    """Right rotation by one moves range end to range start."""
    # [1,2,3] right 1 => [3,1,2], so [3,1,2,4,5][0]=3 (old arr[2]=3)
    assert find_Element([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [[0, 2]], 1, 0) == 3


def test_issue_prefix_interior_shift():
    """Elements inside rotated range shift right by one."""
    # [1,2,3] right 1 => [3,1,2], so [3,1,2,4,5][1]=1 (old arr[0]=1)
    assert find_Element([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [[0, 2]], 1, 1) == 1


def test_issue_outside_range_unchanged():
    """Index outside rotated range keeps original value."""
    # [1,2,3,4,5] -> [0,2] => [3,1,2,4,5]; index 4 is outside 0-2 so 5
    assert find_Element([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [[0, 2]], 1, 4) == 5


def test_issue_full_array_rotation():
    """Rotating whole array moves last element to index zero."""
    # [1,2,3,4,5] with [0,4] right 1 => [5,1,2,3,4]; [0]=5 (old arr[4]=5)
    assert find_Element([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [[0, 4]], 1, 0) == 5


def test_issue_singleton_range_noop():
    """Range of length one leaves element unchanged."""
    # [1,2,3] with [1,1] right 1 => [1,2,3]; [1]=2
    assert find_Element([1, 2, 3], [[1, 1]], 1, 1) == 2


def test_issue_partial_rotations():
    """Only first `rotations` ranges are applied."""
    # only [0,2]: [1,2,3,4,5] => [3,1,2,4,5]; [1]=1, not 3 from both ranges
    assert find_Element([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [[0, 2], [0, 3]], 1, 1) == 1


def test_issue_disjoint_chained_rotations():
    """Sequential rotations on disjoint ranges compose."""
    # [1,2,3,4] -> [0,1] => [2,1,3,4] -> [2,3] => [2,1,4,3]; [2]=4 (old arr[3]=4)
    assert find_Element([1, 2, 3, 4], [[0, 1], [2, 3]], 2, 2) == 4


def test_contract_signature_arity():
    """Public interface shows find_Element takes four parameters."""
    # arr + ranges + rotations + index = 4 params, 1+1+1+1=4
    assert len(inspect.signature(find_Element).parameters) == 4


def test_contract_function_callable():
    """Module solution must expose callable find_Element."""
    # 1 function object present so callable check = True
    assert callable(find_Element) == True
